fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/TabbedModelOffers.cy.js#UtilityPages - TabbedModelOffers [selectYourTruck] [hi] — Select Your Truck TC-TMO-01: Check Offers lead submits successfully on every tab of Select Your Truck
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TMO-01
**Title:** Check Offers lead submits successfully on every tab of Select Your Truck
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open the Select Your Truck page, and for each tab in "एप्लिकेशन द्वारा लोकप्रिय मॉडल", click a model card's "Check Offers" button, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after each tab's lead submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Select Your Truck page
2. For each tab in "एप्लिकेशन द्वारा लोकप्रिय मॉडल": select the tab, click a model card's "Check Offers" button
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation, then close and move to the next tab
